title: Internal runtime error, IllegalStateException
body:

This Issue was already raised in #337 

I was able to reproduce this behavior with the Sample App:
## Steps to reproduce

Used Device: Samsung Galaxy S3 (Android 4.3)
1. Put Phone into Landscape Mode (unclear if really needed)
2. Select Content, I've used the "Google Play" Sample (Youtube DASH)
3. While it Initially Loads, Instantly Seek To another Position.
4. watch it burn. (Check the Logs)

It might need a few tries to See The Result, since it seems to occur randomly. However it seems like it is a problem with seeking while in some loading process.

On Larger Content with higher quality (e.G. Movies) this occurs more frequently.

I was not able to reproduce it on my Nexus 5 running Android 6
